name: yapper
description: Free medical interview simulation game for healthcare students (nursing, PA, medical). Styled like a 16-bit GBA game. Players practice patient interviews in timed sessions against an AI-powered simulated patient (Alex Morgan) running on a local SLM (Llama2-based, 29 MB, ~112–120 tokens/sec on i5/8GB RAM). Runs on Windows, macOS, and Linux via Java.
author: 02developer (ohtwodeveloper@gmail.com)

download.note: yapper.jar is 80 MB (includes embedded Llama2 SLM model.bin). Download directly from GitHub — not stored in this repo due to binary size.

install.requirements: Java 21+ (OpenJDK recommended). No API key needed — fully local SLM.

game: 16-bit GBA-style visual aesthetic (Zelda: Minish Cap inspired)
Sex-variable patient for sex-specific history practice
patient: Worsens with stress and large meals; occasionally nausea/sour taste
Graphic designer, married, no significant PMH
Responds to open/closed questions, ROS, social history, etc.
ai: ~112–120 tokens/sec on 8th-gen i5 with 8 GB RAM

legacy.note: yapper-legacy/ contains older macOS .app bundles (v2.0) in English, German, and Spanish. Not cross-platform.

security_review.notes: JAR inspected via jar tf + javap + strings. ProcessBuilder only launches 'java -jar Llama2App.jar' locally — no outbound HTTP/socket calls. model.bin is a 29MB local SLM weight file. script.sh only does chmod+x for legacy macOS app. No eval, no remote code fetch.
